rec.title: Structure recorder
rec.intro: To build the {{platform}} connector I need to know how the site talks to its server. This records only the shape of those calls (field names and types), never titles, messages, tokens, cookies or ids. The report stays on this Mac until you choose to send it.
rec.pick: Select a profile above to use the recorder.
rec.step1: Click “Sign in” to bring the {{platform}} window of this app to the front (its title says “{{platform}} — sign in”). Sign in there if needed.
rec.step3: Use only that window, not the {{platform}} desktop app, which cannot be recorded. Scroll the chat list, open a few chats (one with an image if you have it), open a pinned folder and a project, and open the archive: profile menu → Settings → Data controls → Archived chats → Manage. Exact wording may vary.
rec.step4: Click “Stop and save report”, then check the file. Send it to me, or tell me what to change.
rec.checkFirst: It contains structure only, but open it and check before sharing.
rec.write1: In the ChatGPT window, create a throwaway chat: send it one short message so it appears in your list.
rec.write2: Click “Start recording”. Then, in that window and on that chat only: rename it, archive it, restore it from the archive, and finally delete it.
rec.write3: These are real actions on that chat, and the delete cannot be undone. Use a chat you do not care about.
rec.write4: Click “Stop and save report”. The report keeps the shape of those requests, never the title you typed.

changes.title: Changes on {{platform}}
changes.pick: Select a profile above to choose whether this app may change things on the platform.
changes.intro: By default this app only reads {{platform}}. Renaming, archiving or deleting here changes only your copy. Turn this on for a profile to send those changes to {{platform}} as well.
changes.unsupported: This app cannot rename, archive or delete on {{platform}} yet. It needs a recording of {{platform}}’s own requests for those actions (see the recorder below), so nothing can be turned on for now.
changes.allow: Allow this app to change things on {{platform}} for {{account}}
changes.on: On: renames, archives and deletes you make for this profile are sent to {{platform}} one at a time. See Activity.
changes.confirmBody: Renaming, archiving and deleting chats of {{account}} in this app will also be done on {{platform}}, one at a time and unhurried. Nothing is sent for other profiles.
changes.confirmDelete: Deleting on the platform is permanent there. Before each delete, a full verified copy of the chat is saved in:
changes.confirmRisk: This app is unofficial. Automating changes on {{platform}} may go against its terms and could lead to restrictions on your account. You can turn this off at any time.

welcome.title: Welcome to Unified AI Chats
welcome.lead: Connect your first account and your chats appear here, organized and searchable.
welcome.pointSync: The first import starts by itself and can take a few minutes. After that, new chats arrive in the background.
welcome.pointLocal: Everything stays on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere except to the platforms you connect.
welcome.pointRead: The app only reads from a platform, unless you turn on changes for a profile.
